data.title: task list --search runs on the search engine
data.description: Two ways to search in one product: kadence search (BM25 over the folded journal, tokenized, coverage-gated) and task list --search (lowercase substring over title, description and comments). The owner chose on 2026-09-29 to put task list --search on the same engine: word matching with the same tokenizer, every task that holds the question rather than the top five, ranked by relevance unless --sort is given, filters unchanged. The TUI / filter stays a substring - it is a live filter for a person typing. Also: write the lookup cost ladder (measured 2026-09-29 on 75 questions) into .kadence/README.md and, in brief, the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md section.
